verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe skills as reusable folders of markdown instructions, scripts and resources for agents. User-invocable skills appear as slash commands, `grok inspect` reports discovered skills, and a Marketplace tab installs plugins. Together these show the agent can be equipped with custom specialized capabilities. Missing for 10: detailed authoring documentation (skill file location/format, how custom skills are created and scoped), independent or hands-on corroboration of custom skills working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Skills are reusable folders containing markdown instructions, script files, and resources for agents.
User-invocable skills also appear as slash commands, for example `/<skill-name>`.
use `grok inspect` to see what Grok discovered in the current directory, including config sources, instructions, skills, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers
The TUI includes a Marketplace tab for browsing and installing plugins from configured sources.
